entries.title: 1 Chronicles 20:2
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: To weigh a talent - Or, to be worth a talent, that is, five thousand four hundred and seventy five pounds.

entries.title: 1 Chronicles 20:8
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: They fell, &c - We need not fear great men against us, while we have the great God for us.
